text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 84 vials of eribulin mesylate 0.5 mg/mL 2 mL with daily use of 4.8 vials, providing 17.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show eribulin mesylate is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers less than three weeks. No manufacturer is on FDA's shortage list today. The first ranked supplier, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., sources from Kindos Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., whose most recent inspection was classified VAI on 2024-07-19. The remaining ranked options (Apotex Corp., BSP Pharmaceuticals SpA, Baxter Healthcare Company, Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.) have no identifiable plant on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place an order with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires approval by Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to qualify Apotex Corp. as a secondary source — requires approval by Pharmacy Director and Quality Assurance.
3. Buyer to qualify BSP Pharmaceuticals SpA as a tertiary source — requires approval by Pharmacy Director and Quality Assurance.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes — requires approval by Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until inventory falls below seven days; relying solely on current stock without securing additional supply agreements.
